title: Teamwork Works Best With a Team
transcript: Hi. I am walking to work. Today my boss will tell me what she thinks of my work. Is it good? Or is it bad? Okay, time for work. I am going right now. Okay, okay, I’m going!
Sit down. As you know, at the start of a new year we have a work review.
Yes. Anna, this chart shows the audience of The Time Traveling Treehouse. If you look at it, you will see something bad. Your audience is going down, down, DOWN!
Ms. Weaver, I think the chart is upside down.
Here, let’s flip that around. Now, it’s right-side up.
Oh. If you look at this chart, you will see something good. Your audience is big.
I want to see these numbers go up, and up, and UP!
You really ought to think seriously about them. I like this one. Please read it.
“If at first you SUCCEED; you will be a success.” Well, it's a cute cat.
Here’s another one. I like it.
“WORKING HARD looks hard because it really is hard.” I see. It's another cute cat.
“TEAMWORK works best with a team.” A team of cats. Look at all those cats!
So, Anna, do you understand what I want?
Okay, team. There is a problem in the Treehouse.
No, it is not big enough.
Please don’t worry. I know what Ms. Weaver wants. Here’s the plan. (whispers)
Good job, team. This is exactly what Ms. Weaver wants!
Welcome to The Time Traveling Treehouse! Today you will learn about a very popular pet … cats!
Anna. Did I give you enough cats?
I don’t know, MINDY. I think we need more cats!
